resources.string: A view-only floating chat viewer that syncs with the official app

This is an unofficial app and is not affiliated with YouTube or Google. It fetches chat in an undocumented way (the same requests the YouTube web app uses), so it may stop working without notice when YouTube changes. It has no features for writing, such as posting comments.
Used to show the chat window over the official app.
Required to read the playback position (video, position and speed) of the official app. Android names this permission this way, but Romcha does not read the content of your notifications.
Used for the ongoing notification that shows the window is active, and for show/hide and stop from it.
This is not a readable YouTube video URL
No YouTube video URL was found in the shared content
No playback detected in the official app (check that notification access is allowed and that the official app is playing)
Change the items shown in chat, filters, NG words, the floating window settings and the theme.
Time (position in the video for replays, post time for live)
Follow system (the floating window stays dark)
Off shows all chat; on fetches only the top chat YouTube picks. Switching reloads the chat.
Only chat matching any of the types you turn on is shown (nothing is filtered when all are off).
Chat containing these is hidden. Case-insensitive (limit: %1$d)
A higher value lets you scroll back further but uses more memory. The change applies the next time you open a video.
Larger header buttons (easier to tap, but the title gets narrower)
Text size and background opacity can be changed from the settings button of the floating window.
Cleared the video identification cache. If the window is showing, the current video is identified again.
Use this when chat from a different video is shown. It clears the identified videos and identifies the current one again.
Saves window and display settings and NG words to your Google account\u2019s automatic backup and restores them on reinstall. Identified videos are not saved.
Resets window and display settings and NG words to their defaults and stops the floating window. The backup and crash report switches stay as they are.
Reset settings to their defaults? This cannot be undone.
When the app crashes, sends the error details, app and OS versions, device model and an anonymous ID to Firebase Crashlytics. Chat and video URLs are not sent.
